title: Delivery Sync & Spec Update
summary: After verification passes, update linked source documentation to match delivered behaviour and record implementation evidence on a Change Request, Bug Fix Spec, milestone, or Work Scope Brief. Missing linked PRD or Design titles are reported and skipped. Continue here after a passing review when specs must catch up to the change. Launch with empty inputs to discover eligible work items. SpecX documents only — it does not deploy, publish, tag, or release software.
